title: GamesIndexDocumentDeletedPayload
description: games.index_document.deleted v1 (OpenVibe.Games apps/server/src/worlds/searchIndex.ts, via openvibe-publishing/search-feed). A Search tombstone for a creator world page (/worlds/<id>) that is no longer published (unpublished, taken down by staff, or deleted). Only sent for a page Search was sent before, and only when the tombstone's revision moved. Consumed by OpenVibe.Search ('*.index_document.*'). Envelope: subject { type: world, id, revision }, visibility internal, actor service:games.

revision.description: Index revision of the tombstone; wins over any document at the same or an older revision.
